label: Fires at GO after a common unrewarded a2 trial, mostly at trials 60-89, stronger after two losses and S1-leaning belief.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * isin(ep_dec, [6, 7, 8]) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_lo
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 60) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 60) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 60) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 60) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 60)
explanation: Sparse feature (0.9% of steps). It is silent at D1 and D2 and fires only at GO. Almost all of it comes after a previous trial that was a2 -> S2 (common) and unrewarded, and the timing baseline already rises over the episode. Beyond timing, its size is larger in trials 60-89 (smaller in the last decile), when the trial before was also unrewarded (two losses in a row), and when the observer belief has moved toward S1 (higher belief_lo, i.e. evidence that S2 is no longer good). The other last-trial patterns lower it slightly. The free fit (dev 0.39 vs short 0.31) adds interactions: belief_lo and two losses matter mainly in the late window, a repeated a2 two trials back helps, and there is a drop at trials 90+. The full gating, last-trial pattern x late window x second loss x belief, needs more than three factors per term, so the short form cannot hold it. No future or model-output variables are used.
